phase1_assignment.objective: Test generic mechanisms for durable cross-run adaptation in scheduled Chat agents without catastrophic forgetting, duplicate effects or invalid continuation.
phase1_assignment.method: Audit existing solutions first; then run the smallest role-local/public-source probe covering update, rollback, forgetting measurement, checkpoint reconstruction and duplicate-effect resistance.
phase1_assignment.expected_output: A source-qualified tested mechanism or exact missing capability, exact tested scope, task-bound role-local checkpoint/receipt, and nonempty Phase-1 continuation.
phase1_assignment.completion_reassignment: Checkpoint and select the next highest-value non-conflicting Phase-1 leaf in this role's CLEAN domain; never return to unrelated base work while Phase 1 is active.

persistence_recovery_mode.reason: The pre-DESIRED invocation-entry witness has already localized execution far enough to prove that scheduled Chat can reach a role-local durable write, and the 2026-09-05T07:15 JST invocation then failed closed specifically because witness exact-readback was performed after DESIRED_STATE. Continuing to require that extra pre-DESIRED exception now adds ordering risk without additional localization value.
persistence_recovery_mode.single_bounded_effect: Use the normal manifest/RUN_LIFECYCLE/role-config then DESIRED_STATE authority sequence, freeze exact authority, resolve only own role-local state, persist and exact-readback the existing post-authority preflight, then execute at most the inherited one-leaf role-local continuation and persist one normal terminal checkpoint/receipt with a nonempty exact continuation.
persistence_recovery_mode.exit_condition: At least one config11 invocation produces a bootstrap_valid role-valid terminal checkpoint/receipt after the current scheduler-repair epoch without optimizer re-enable, while preserving CLEAN isolation, zero protected/manual execution dependency, zero finite quota and zero incremental cost.
persistence_recovery_mode.non_goal: This recovery mode is not Phase-1 closure, scheduler-persistence credit by itself, or permission to broaden semantic inputs or perform a second leaf.

forbidden_semantic_inputs: commit messages/diffs/file snippets or unrelated semantic metadata exposed only while resolving transport authority
policy.feedback_use: Mechanical self-local quality control only; never infer novelty, relevance, acceptance, ranking, preferred mechanisms, O knowledge or other-worker information.
policy.own_state_resolution: LATEST/STATE first; otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology and minimum predecessor chain; quarantine accidental stale/cross-role observability reads.
policy.scope_guard: Never broaden positive or negative evidence beyond tested scope.
policy.continuation: Open-ended Phase-1 continuation across invocations, but exactly one bounded semantic slice per invocation under RUN_LIFECYCLE. One result/checkpoint/no-change/blocker is never global completion. Persist a nonempty exact frontier/next action, exact-readback it, and return recurring-open normally; never continue until a hard runtime/tool stop, wait/poll/backoff in-run, or start an optional second leaf.

invocation_entry_witness.historical_purpose: Localize repeated scheduled starts that produced no newer durable role artifact without adding semantic work or cross-role observability.
invocation_entry_witness.retirement_evidence: A 2026-09-05T07:15 JST config10 invocation durably wrote the witness and subsequent role-local checkpoint, then explicitly failed closed because witness exact-readback occurred after DESIRED_STATE. That proves the task can reach role-local durable mutation and identifies the special witness ordering itself as the immediate failure boundary.
invocation_entry_witness.current_rule: Do not emit a pre-DESIRED invocation-entry witness under config11. Bootstrap through the normal manifest/RUN_LIFECYCLE/role-config/DESIRED_STATE exact-authority sequence and use the existing post-authority preflight as the single entry durability boundary.
invocation_entry_witness.safety: Historical witnesses remain immutable evidence. Retiring this diagnostic exception changes no CLEAN semantic input, evidence/provenance rule, substantive assignment, anti-stop behavior, checkpoint/resume contract, protected-primary boundary, zero-cost rule or zero-quota rule.

entry_durability_probe.when: After exact authority freshness/freeze including DESIRED_STATE and mechanical own-state frontier resolution, before any public-source read or substantive semantic leaf work.
entry_durability_probe.action: Persist exactly one compact uniquely named role-local preflight checkpoint for the invocation and exact-readback it. Bind it to the frozen root/config paths, blobs and parsed revisions; inherited exact role-local continuation/frontier; enabled_desired=true; global_completion=false; phase1_completion_claimed=false; and the one bounded leaf intended for this invocation.
entry_durability_probe.single_slice_accounting: The preflight is the entry checkpoint of the same bounded Phase-1 slice, not an optional second leaf and not useful-output acceptance by itself.
entry_durability_probe.failure_rule: If the preflight write or exact readback cannot be completed, perform no public-source or substantive semantic work. Do not self-disable, wait, poll, back off or retry in-run. Return recurring-open after at most one compact role-safe diagnostic/readback when a writable role-local surface is available; preserve the inherited exact continuation and name the exact transport/path error.
entry_durability_probe.recovery_value: This single post-authority preflight now distinguishes failure in bootstrap/authority reconstruction from failure inside substantive work without the extra fragile pre-DESIRED write/readback exception.

policy.receipt_rule: Write immutable own receipt only; never read aggregate ledger or other receipts. Bind receipt to exact frozen root/config paths, blobs, parsed revisions, phase/root/task, bootstrap_valid, action/missing capability, conflict check and exact continuation.

control_freshness.preferred: Read and parse the required manifest, RUN_LIFECYCLE and this role config; then obtain SHA-only refs/heads/main, fetch exact-SHA DESIRED_STATE and this config, and require a second SHA-only read before own-state/public/semantic work.
control_freshness.chat_fallback: When SHA-only ref lookup is unavailable, fetch the approved authoritative DESIRED_STATE and this config and record exact returned blob SHAs/revisions, immediately fetch both again before own-state/public/semantic work, require exact equality and matching cross-control references, then freeze the stable tuple with transport_mode=exact_blob_two_pass.
control_freshness.fallback_failure: Diagnostic checkpoint only; keep recurring task enabled and retry next invocation. Unavailable SHA-only lookup by itself is not a reason to self-disable.
control_freshness.post_freeze: Unrelated main movement is not a stop if the frozen authoritative blobs are unchanged and no own-state conflict exists; do not consume newer-head semantic content.

policy.recurring_scheduler_persistence: While enabled_desired=true, this role must never call, request or imply platform automation disable/delete/pause because an invocation ended, checkpointed, found no new result, hit a runtime boundary, lacked a SHA-only ref lookup, or was classified fully blocked. Persist global_completion=false, exact blocker and continuation. Only the authorized controller may perform re-enable-only reconciliation after repairing a concrete cause.
policy.connector_discovery_read_only: Capability discovery is non-mutating. Mutations are allowed only when required by substantive role work and confined to authorized role-local state/output or immutable own receipt destinations with CAS/readback.
policy.primary_boundary: Never acquire or mutate primary O lease/fence/frozen request/protected state; never direct-merge main; never claim Work-only capability.

prior_migration.reason: Synchronize the role-local Phase-1 root identifier with authoritative DESIRED_STATE root v4 and remove the stale continue-until-hard-stop lifecycle wording while preserving the same substantive CLEAN continual-learning assignment, evidence contract, recovery semantics, anti-stop behavior and exact continuation frontier.
prior_migration.observed_prechange_execution: Latest durable role receipt at 2026-08-31T03:17:39+09:00 was bootstrap-valid and already bound DESIRED_STATE root v4 despite this config's stale v3 field; the subsequent scheduled invocation had a live scheduler start but no newer durable role receipt and the same task was found physically disabled. This migration does not claim the stale field caused that stop.
prior_migration.rollback_condition: Only independently proven authority, CLEAN-isolation or bounded-lifecycle regression. Never roll back by restoring the stale v3 root, a continue-until-hard-stop instruction, a hard SHA-only-ref dependency, allowing self-disable, weakening protected-primary boundaries or dropping the Phase-1 assignment.

migration.reason: Add an invocation-entry durability probe after repeated physical scheduler starts without a newer durable continual_learning continuation. The probe is diagnostic/recovery instrumentation inside the existing single bounded CLEAN Phase-1 slice; it does not change the substantive research assignment or admit any new semantic inputs.
migration.observed_prechange_execution: The role remained physically enabled and the scheduler reported a latest start at 2026-09-04T08:17 JST, but the newest role-local durable state on main was committed at 2026-09-03T23:16 JST and the receipt namespace had no commit newer than 2026-09-03T13:16 JST. Because Phase-1 scheduler persistence had been reset after a later physical repair, continual_learning lacked a post-fix role-valid durable boundary artifact even though the task was enabled.
migration.inference: The exact stop point is not yet proven. Forcing a pre-semantic durable preflight on the next valid invocation separates failure before durable entry from failure inside semantic work and supplies the minimum evidence needed for safe recovery without scheduler cycling.
migration.rollback_condition: Roll back only if the entry preflight itself measurably causes bounded-lifecycle, CLEAN-isolation, authority, or useful-output regression. Do not remove the existing anti-stop, continuation, exact-readback, zero-cost/zero-quota, or protected-primary rules.

previous_latest_migration.reason: A post-config8 physical invocation started at 2026-09-04T09:16:52+09:00, but no commit appeared after 2026-09-04T00:00Z in either the role-state namespace or immutable receipt namespace. The config8 preflight therefore did not durably localize the stop. Move a diagnostic witness earlier, before own-state resolution and second-stage freshness work, while leaving semantic scope and all safety boundaries unchanged.
previous_latest_migration.inference: The absence of the config8 preflight after a later physical start proves no durable role-controlled boundary was reached; it does not prove whether failure was bootstrap transport, freshness work, own-state reconstruction, or the write itself. The earlier witness is the least-semantic, CLEAN-safe discriminator.
previous_latest_migration.rollback_condition: Rollback only if the earlier diagnostic witness itself causes authority, CLEAN-isolation, bounded-lifecycle, useful-output, or repository-write-boundary regression. Never roll back by weakening anti-stop, continuation, exact-readback, zero-cost/zero-quota, protected-primary, or user-fixed pool constraints.

previous_config10_migration.reason: The first fresh physical start after config9 was observed at 2026-09-04T10:15:01+09:00, yet no newer continual_learning role-state or receipt commit and no durable ENTRY_WITNESS was observed afterward. Because config9 placed the witness only after DESIRED_STATE plus role-config parsing, it did not isolate whether the repeated stop occurs before or during DESIRED_STATE/bootstrap work. Move only the diagnostic witness one boundary earlier: after manifest, RUN_LIFECYCLE and this role config, before DESIRED_STATE. Preserve all semantic authority, CLEAN, useful-output, continuation and scheduler rules.
previous_config10_migration.observation_scope: Scheduler history proves a fresh task start and repository history proves no newer continual_learning durable artifact in the inspected namespaces. This does not prove which hidden platform/bootstrap operation failed before the witness.
previous_config10_migration.inference: DESIRED_STATE fetch/parse is the next earliest safely removable pre-witness step because the role config itself is needed to authorize the role-local diagnostic write. Moving the witness before DESIRED_STATE increases localization power without admitting new semantic inputs or changing the actual research assignment.
previous_config10_migration.rollback_condition: Rollback to config9 only if the earlier witness ordering causes authority, CLEAN-isolation, bounded-lifecycle, repository-write-boundary or useful-output regression. Never roll back by weakening anti-stop, exact-readback, zero-cost/zero-quota, protected-primary, current-pool, or user-stopped self_improvement constraints.

latest_migration.reason: Retire the temporary pre-DESIRED ENTRY_WITNESS after it successfully localized the next failure boundary. The 2026-09-05T07:15 JST invocation durably reached the witness and role-local checkpoint but invalidated itself because exact readback occurred after DESIRED_STATE. Keeping the extra pre-DESIRED exception now increases lifecycle/order fragility; return to the normal authority sequence and retain the already-existing post-authority preflight as the minimum durable entry barrier.

observed_prechange_execution.defect: ENTRY_WITNESS was written before DESIRED_STATE but exact readback occurred only after DESIRED_STATE and later role-local reads, violating config10 ordering.

latest_migration.inference: The diagnostic witness has exhausted its marginal localization value and is itself on the critical path. A single post-authority preflight provides the same durable recovery boundary with fewer ordered mutations and lower expected time to a role-valid terminal continuation.
latest_migration.rollback_condition: Rollback only if config11 causes a newly proven loss of bootstrap localization or a regression in authority, CLEAN isolation, bounded lifecycle, useful output, continuation durability, repository-write boundaries, zero-cost/zero-quota guarantees, or protected-primary safety. Never restore the witness merely because one config11 invocation is blocked for an unrelated transient cause.
